globalDescription: Global dictionaries for the automatic medical term correction. They only take effect in the categories they are attached to, and every user can attach them to their own categories.
personalDescription: Your own dictionaries, visible only to you, not even to administrators. They apply automatically to all your recordings, whatever the category, without attaching them anywhere.
attachHint: A dictionary only takes effect once it is attached to a category under Categories. This lets you test small dictionaries in a targeted way.
confirmDeleteUsed: Delete dictionary “{{name}}”? It is attached to {{count}} category(ies) and will be removed there.
name: Name
moreTerms: … and {{count}} more. Narrow the search to see them.
uploadFormat:
.txt or .csv, UTF-8, at most 5 MB.
One term per line; empty lines and lines starting with # are ignored. Commas inside a term are kept.
For .csv the first column is used (delimiter ; or ,); comment out a header line with #.
Duplicate terms are removed, at most 50,000 terms of up to 200 characters each.
uploadDiscardsChanges: Unsaved changes to the list will be lost by the upload. Continue?
